About these 21 rides

They ride on 6 days of the week; Tuesday and Thursday have the most, 5 each; only Friday has none. The earliest start is James Bros. Bikes Saturday Shop Ride at 7:00 am; the latest is Thursday Night Dirtbags at 7:00 pm. After work, 13 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 9 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 8. There’s one ride made for women, trans and femme riders and 2 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
